children: Industrial & Commercial Bank of China is scheduled to report its third-quarter results on Friday. Here's what you need to know:

NET PROFIT FORECAST: ICBC's net profit is expected to have risen 2.2% to 104.00 billion yuan, equivalent to $15.60 billion, for the three months ended September, according to a poll of analysts by Visible Alpha. The bank booked net profit of 101.805 billion yuan in the year-earlier period.
Its Hong Kong-listed stock has risen 24% year to date, supported by China's resilient economic growth and eased fears about the central bank's rate cuts, which could narrow net interest margins.

First-half net interest income--the difference between interest earned on loans and that paid on deposits--increased 8.8% to 341.24 billion yuan due to lower interest expenses. Investors will be closely watching for signs of further improvement in the bank's primary source of earnings.

Credit impairment losses widened to 127.02 billion yuan in the first half from 104.01 billion yuan in the year-earlier period. Investors will be focusing on credit costs as the Iran war and higher fuel prices raised economic uncertainty in the world's second-biggest economy.
The lender's nonperforming-loan ratio was 1.29% as of the end of June, down from 1.31% at end-2025. Investors will be paying attention to further signs of improvement in asset quality.
